author: GamingBolt
description:
Even with its issues, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (2026) is an enjoyable experience. It's unabashedly over-the-top but does so with a sense of restraint that's as surprising as it is welcome. Your mileage will vary on whether it's worth $70, but for the first time since the original three games, Call of Duty has finally delivered an enjoyable campaign. 

As a reminder this is a review in progress, we will be back later this week with our final review and score which will also include our multiplayer impressions.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 2026 Campaign Review- Does It Deliver This Time? [Review in Progress]

author: GamingBolt
description:
With only ten days until Phantom Blade Zero's release, many questions linger. Will protagonist Soul survive his ordeal? Can he overcome his failing health and ultimately live life on his own terms? What secrets does Wulin hold? It's a kung fu odyssey, and the sheer attention to detail in its world, combat and visuals has us excited.

Thankfully, several new details are available ahead of its October 29th launch on PS5 and PC. Whether it's about acquiring weapons or exploration, S-Game's action RPG has a lot going on.
title: Phantom Blade Zero - 15 NEW Details You Need to Know Before You Pre-Order
